kdwe01.title: Scorpio's Unbothered Timer
kdwe01.caption:
Replied in one second. Scheduled it for two hours later.
The mystery is a timer, and the timer is for Scorpio. Who in your group chat runs on a send delay?

kdwe02.title: Virgo's Off-Camera Room
kdwe02.caption:
The spotless corner is real. So is the sock on the lamp.
First-date Virgo and Tuesday Virgo live in the same room. Which one answers your video calls?

kdwe03.title: Leo Rehearses Being Casual
kdwe03.caption:
Thirty takes of "oh, didn't see you there" to a cardboard crush.
Then the real one walks in and Leo forgets every line. Tag the friend who practises small talk.

kdwe04.title: Cancer's Hoodie Box
kdwe04.caption:
The box says DONATE. The box has said DONATE for a while.
Moving on is real, the hoodie just has a longer timeline. What's still in your box?

kdwe05.title: Gemini's Three Group Chats
kdwe05.caption:
It's nothing. We're basically dating. Who?
Same crush, three group chats, three completely different stories. One "hey" and all of them find out. Which chat gets the real version?
